dslRule:
<!id: junit.assert.assertTrue.identity.to.assert_same>
<!description: Replace JUnit Assert.assertTrue(message, x == y) with Assert.assertSame(message, y, x) for reference equality checks, improving clarity and adhering to JUnit's idiomatic assert methods.>
<!severity: HINT>
org.junit.Assert.assertTrue($message$, $var1$ == $var2$) :: instanceof($var1$, "java.lang.Object") && instanceof($var2$, "java.lang.Object")
=>
org.junit.Assert.assertSame($message$, $var2$, $var1$)
;;

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
